summary: A caseworker asks {person} to point out where a water discount termination letter explains how to appeal.
realLife: After a case in which a Portland customer was not told about an appeal, the bureau agreed to revise its guidelines to require written notice of available appeal rights.
gates: A termination letter exists and the local program provides a review route.
inGame: needs: a termination letter exists and the local program provides a review route.

turns.pulledBy: The notice omits the appeal instructions.
turns.what: Ask the bureau to provide the missing instructions.
turns.writesBack: The resident has a pending request for written appeal instructions.

turns.what: Help the resident locate the filing deadline and destination.
turns.writesBack: The resident knows where and when to submit the appeal.
